__what_the_steps_mean__.head <pan> <tilt> <seconds>: Point the head. pan: + is left, - is right, up to 72. tilt: + is up to 14, - is down to 24. seconds: how long the move takes, e.g. 'head 40 10 0.4'. Attention takes the head back 3 seconds after the last head step.
__what_the_steps_mean__.turn <degrees>: Turn the whole robot on the spot. + is left, - is right, e.g. 'turn 30'.
__what_the_steps_mean__.drive <metres>: Roll straight. + is forward (at most 0.5 m), - is backward (at most 0.3 m). Forward stops by itself when something is closer than 45 cm, backward has no sensor, so keep it short.
__what_the_steps_mean__.gesture <name>: Play an arm motion: wave, nod, cheer, greet (offers the right hand for a handshake), farewell. A gesture the robot doesn't have is skipped.
__what_the_steps_mean__.expression <name>: Set the face: happy, excited, neutral, sad, surprised, thinking, confused, shy, angry. It stays until the emote ends.
__what_the_steps_mean__.say <text>: Say a line out loud in Dutch, e.g. 'say Goedemorgen!'.
__what_the_steps_mean__.music <on|off>: Start or stop the dance music on ARI's speaker. The music always stops when the emote ends.

__how_to_add_one__: Add a name with a list of steps below. It shows up on the iPad the next time the page refreshes, no restart needed. The Dans has no driving on purpose, because people stand close to ARI at the stand.

Dans: say Zo, dat was mijn dansje. Bewegen is gezond, ook voor een robot!
Hallo: say Hallo! Ik ben ARI, de gids van het VUmc.
